text:
alex: Quick ask — can someone share memory-bandwidth and kernel timing differences between A100, H100, and L40S for the 30B transformer we use? Trying to explain throughput drop at long context.

maria: Do you have specific configs? fp16/bf16, tensor cores on, context len, batch sizes?

alex: fp16, cuda 12.1, no quant, sequence lengths 1024 and 8192, batch sizes 1 and 4. We see tokens/sec on H100 lower than expected at 8k.

devon: quick sanity run I did earlier (not tuned):
```
Model: redwood-30b
H100 (A100 perf mode): seq=1024 b=1 -> 350 tok/s, seq=8192 b=1 -> 90 tok/s
A100: seq=1024 b=1 -> 320 tok/s, seq=8192 b=1 -> 75 tok/s
L40S: seq=1024 b=1 -> 280 tok/s, seq=8192 b=1 -> 65 tok/s
```
Numbers rough, no KV cache reuse. Might be memory bandwidth limit at long context.

sam: Useful. Can you capture nvprof/nsys kernel breakdown? I want to see memcpy vs matmul times.

devon: Uploaded quick trace snippet (summarized):
```
Total time breakdown (8192, b=1): memcpy 45%, matmul 40%, other 15%
H100 memcpy higher due to larger L2+HBM behavior.
```

maria: Could be thrashing on KV cache if we don't pin pages or use CUDA IPC. Also check cublas_algo selection — H100 prefers different algos for large M.

alex: How should I run to capture deterministic kernels? Any flags.

sam: Run with:
```
NSYS_PROFILER_CAPTURE_RANGE=nvtx nsys profile --output=run.nsys --trace=cuda,osrt python serve.py --max-seq 8192 --batch 1
# and enable
TF_ALLOW_CUDA_TENSORCORE=1
```

infra-bot: Reminder: long traces may hit storage quota. Archive to s3://redwood-profiling if >1GB.

devon: Also try lowering workspace fragmentation: set env CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY and reuse processes. And run with --kv-cache on/off to isolate.

maria: One other quick check — test 8-bit quant (bitsandbytes) on A100 vs H100; kernels differ and could shift mem bottleneck.

alex: Thanks — I'll run the traces for seq 8192 b=1 and attach results here. If someone can scan the nsys timeline after I upload, that'd help.

sam: Happy to. Ping me with link. :+1:

alex: Uploading s3 link in a bit. ETA ~30m.
